deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.
deletion_policy.rationale: This field controls Terraform deletion behaviour rather than access control or data protection. It is a lifecycle management setting and is not enforced as a generic platform security control.

ingress_policy_name.description: The name of the Service Perimeter to add this resource to.
ingress_policy_name.rationale: Names the Service Perimeter that this ingress policy attaches to; it is a reference to another resource (the perimeter), and platform policy does not constrain which named perimeter a team attaches to.

resource.description: A GCP resource that is inside of the service perimeter.
resource.rationale: Identifies the GCP resource referenced by the ingress policy; it is a pointer to a specific project/resource and cannot be constrained by a generic platform policy without hardcoding identifiers.
